info.syllabusName: Khoa học dữ liệu trong kinh doanh (Data Science for Business)
info.description: This course introduces students to the fundamentals of data science in the context of logistics and supply chain management. Through the use of modern tools such as Excel and Python, students will learn how to extract insights from data, apply machine learning basics, and make informed business decisions while considering ethical implications and data protection policies.
info.decisionNo: Ban hành theo QĐ CTĐT TDTU

clos.loDetails: Understand core data science concepts and their applications in business and supply chains.
Analyze structured and unstructured data using appropriate tools and techniques.
Interpret business data for decision-making using predictive and descriptive analytics.
Demonstrate the ability to solve real-world logistics and SCM problems using data-driven approaches.
